description: Get a collection's live picks — the lowest-priced product, the fastest to get branded (shortest production window) and the premium pick for executives or designed gifts, each with a named product, From price (AUD ex-GST at volume; MOQ stated separately) and URL — plus buyer FAQs and, for reviewed collections (get_collections detailedGuidance: true), buyer guidance, materials, branding options and live product IDs. Works for every slug in get_collections. On the tech gadgets, power bank, USB drive, wireless charger, tote, polo shirt and T-shirt collections it also returns `priceLadder`: the cheapest product per type, fabric, capacity or material with its branded unit price at MOQ and at 100 / 250 / 500 / 1,000 units, the comparison table the page shows. Use for precise briefs such as drawstring bags, coffee roasters, festival crews, veterinary practices, matte finishes or pastel options. Discover slugs with get_collections. English/AUD reference; use get_product or get_quote for local currency.

locale.description: Locale: en-AU (default), en-US, en-NZ, de-DE, ja-JP — gates AU-only offers and localises the FAQs
